name: Vulgarity
overview: Scripture warns against hasty, corrupt, and unedifying speech, emphasizing that words should build up and minister grace to listeners rather than promote foolishness or filthiness. Believers are called to avoid vulgarity, foolish talking, and jesting that are inappropriate, instead focusing their minds on what is true, honest, just, pure, and lovely. The Bible encourages speaking up for those who cannot defend themselves and using speech to promote godly virtues, reflecting a Christ-centered life marked by thankfulness and grace.
